title: R3.1 Versioned hand-off envelopes and provenance (design, configured mission, synthetic orbit, flight continuation, targeted edit)
title_th: R3.1 สัญญาส่งต่อข้อมูลแบบมีเวอร์ชันและที่มาของข้อมูล (แบบ, ภารกิจ, วางวงโคจรตรง, ต่อจากเที่ยวบิน, แก้ค่าต้นเหตุ)
status_evidence: No envelope module on origin/main da67341: src/orbit/handoff.ts is the only versioned hand-off (DOM-free, parseHandoff refuses unsound input, M-ORBIT-052 done). No design revision id, no flown-input freeze, no attitude/subsystem state in it. R2 left panel.missionState() reads in place (M-LAUNCH-030).
placement: PLAN R3.1 (owner S with P; first R3 task, gate for R3.2–R3.5)
priority_rationale: Every R3 picture, readiness jump and journey needs one source of truth for "which design/flight is this"; without it previews and hand-offs can silently show a draft instead of what flew (realism + data integrity).
acceptance: Envelope types for the five intents with version, source design id + revision, frozen flown inputs, epoch/frame, remaining propellant, attitude where modelled; Build→Launch→Orbit keeps the related values; replay hand-off uses the displayed cursor, not the live head (reproducer first, draft≠flown); invalid/newer envelope refused with an honest message, never a silent default vehicle; legacy mission/design/archive files read per declared migration; unit + browser journey.
quality_guard: Pure schema/adapter work: no physics change, no golden rewrite. Existing mission/design files must keep loading (migration tests on fixtures from every shipped version). Archive bytes of untouched records unchanged.
user_benefit: A student always knows whether they are looking at their design, the configured mission or the flight that actually flew; Continue-in-Orbit never refills fuel or uses a later state.
notes: Sub-items placed in R3.1 elsewhere: M-LAUNCH-030 (post-flight consumers read sim.cfg). Design-record recipe/payload/date persistence (M-BUILD-011) should ride the same schema bump.

title: R3.2 Engineer rocket preview from the design's own geometry (SVG first; assemble/explode, dimensions, part → field)
title_th: R3.2 ภาพจรวดระดับ Engineer จาก geometry ของแบบเอง (SVG ก่อน; ประกอบ/แยกชิ้น, ขนาด, เลือกชิ้นแล้วไปช่องที่เกี่ยวข้อง)
sources: cross:M-LAUNCH-076 (drawing fidelity, absorbed as acceptance rows)
status_evidence: StackSvg/explodedView exist (src/ui/build/stack-svg.ts, src/design/exploded.ts) and are used by build-screen.ts (Watch) and sizing-panel.ts only; engineer-level.ts tabs (stand, tunnel, review, staging) show no rocket picture. Engine layout still keyed by stage id (src/data/engine-layout.ts: re-counted s1 drawn as octaweb).
placement: PLAN R3.2 (owner B-R pure module; B integrates)
priority_rationale: Owner request U04: Engineer numbers need a picture; the picture must be the exact design under test (realism of what the student sees).
depends_on: cross:M-LAUNCH-046 (R3.0 context budget) only before any 3-D view
cross:M-LAUNCH-041 (P11 size-1 render cache) only before any 3-D view
cross:M-LAUNCH-037 (shared canvas/colour helper) for new plots
acceptance: Drawn dimensions/parts equal the VehicleSpec the calculations and Launch use (unit test per catalogue vehicle + custom/remixed/sized variants); assemble/explode never distorts scale; engine layout derived from engine count, not stage id (closes S02-octaweb); swapped engine redraws its own nozzle; published-height deltas for Vega-C/PSLV-XL/Atlas V 551 shown with source or explained (M-LAUNCH-076 rows); keyboard/touch part selection opens the matching tab/field; invalid draft shows a stale/invalid state; screenshots TH/EN/RU at 320/390/1280 px approved.
quality_guard: SVG first: no new WebGL context per tab. Any 3-D interaction waits for R3.0 and reuses the render cache. Drawing changes are visual only: no VehicleSpec/physics change. Bundle budget may not grow beyond a recorded, reviewed increase.
user_benefit: Engineers see the rocket they are actually testing, at true scale, and can click a stage or engine to jump to its numbers.
notes: Launch group (M-LAUNCH-076) states Build owns R3.2: the master plan should keep one id; this item absorbs 076 as acceptance rows.

title: R3.3 Satellite picture and subsystem diagrams from SatelliteDesign (assumptions labelled), incl. Build Watch satellite exploded views
title_th: R3.3 ภาพดาวเทียมและแผนภาพอธิบาย subsystem จาก SatelliteDesign (ระบุสมมติฐาน) รวมภาพแยกชิ้นดาวเทียมในระดับ Watch
sources: other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS D06 "the designer draws no picture"
status_evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md D06 limits: "the designer draws no picture of it"; Build Watch draws rockets only (build-screen.ts StackSvg). No satellite view-model module under src/design or src/ui/build.
placement: PLAN R3.3 (owner B-S pure module; B integrates; S co-owns schema)
priority_rationale: Owner request U04 for the satellite side; diagrams of eclipse/power, link pointing, camera footprint teach the physics that the D06 cores already compute.
depends_on: cross:M-ORBIT-046 (one satellite model contract; LTAN mean-vs-true Sun)
acceptance: View model reads the same SatelliteDesign + figures revision as the numbers; array=0 / no propulsion / no camera / body-mounted vs tracking draw differently; schematic geometry (wing count, aspect, placement) carries an "assumed" label readable in TH/EN/RU; selecting power/propulsion/ADCS/radio/camera highlights and opens controls; diagrams call existing cores (eclipse.ts, power.ts, link.ts, imaging.ts), no physics copy in UI; invalid/stale preview says so; Watch level shows an exploded satellite for catalogue templates.
quality_guard: No second physics implementation in the UI; numbers in diagrams come from the cores (unit test asserts equality). SVG/2D first; no WebGL context until R3.0.
user_benefit: Students see the satellite they designed — arrays, antenna, camera — and why its battery or link works, instead of a table only.

title: R3.4 Build integration: previews in the Engineer shells, readiness issues as typed targets that focus the cause field (A03)
title_th: R3.4 รวม Build: ใส่ภาพเข้า shell ของ Engineer และให้ปัญหา readiness เป็นเป้าหมายแบบมีชนิดที่พาไปช่องต้นเหตุ (A03)
status_evidence: review-panel.ts renders checklist from localized text; no typed target ids (grep "target" in src/design/readiness*.ts finds none); A03 not implemented.
placement: PLAN R3.4 (owner B; shared files build-screen.ts, engineer-level.ts, satellite-level.ts, satellite-bench.ts, review-panel.ts, Build CSS)
priority_rationale: Turns a failed readiness check into one tap to the cause; the largest Build learning-loop gain after the pictures.
acceptance: Each readiness cause maps to a typed target (fairing fit→fairing/payload; weak liftoff→stage/engine/payload; …) by field/part id, never by translated text; activating it opens tab/part/field with focus and scroll, no auto-apply; ambiguous cause offers evidence-backed choices; a changed design invalidates the checked revision; mouse/keyboard/touch and TH/EN/RU at 320/390/1280 px without overflow; Build browser journey extended.
quality_guard: No auto-tune or silent apply (PLAN). Readiness logic unchanged (readiness-core outputs byte-equal for the fleet); only the presentation and a target table are added.
user_benefit: "Fix it" leads straight to the part that causes the problem.
notes: Fold the Build-file engineering items into this package: M-BUILD-026 (D8), M-BUILD-027 (D13), M-BUILD-028 (hidden render), M-BUILD-031 (responsive/locale), M-BUILD-032 (satellite page polish), M-BUILD-009/012 (ratings freshness/write-back).

title: R3.5 Journey integration and Gate G3 (Build→Check→Launch→Result→Edit→Orbit), Build-specific acceptance rows
title_th: R3.5 รวมเส้นทางใช้งานและ Gate G3 (Build→ตรวจ→ปล่อย→ผล→แก้→Orbit) เฉพาะส่วนที่เกี่ยวกับ Build
status_evidence: No ResultAction module; Satellite Engineer save/open/send-to-Orbit exists but not through a shared journey context; G3 not attempted.
placement: PLAN R3.5 (owner I; Build rows by B)
priority_rationale: Ties R3.1–R3.4 together; Build rows are mostly acceptance, the code is I-owned.
acceptance: Custom rocket + satellite fly with matching specs/mass/site/epoch/dynamics; result→typed edit opens frozen inputs or compares with the current draft; draft safe; Send to Orbit at cursor with remaining fuel; G3 walked in TH/EN/RU on phone and desktop.
quality_guard: Result actions never edit a recorded flight; lesson locks and return position kept.
user_benefit: One continuous experiment loop from design to orbit and back.
notes: Home Build chapter (M-LAUNCH-068), first-visit cards (067) and debrief diagnosis (063) are owned by the launch ledger.

title: Ratings search stopped by its 8 s time or flight budget is shown and stored as a real rating (0 kg or a lower bound), and Launch Explore then reads "will not fly"
title_th: ค่า rating ที่ค้นไม่จบเพราะหมดเวลา 8 วินาที/จำนวนเที่ยวบิน ถูกแสดงและบันทึกเป็นค่าจริง (0 kg หรือค่าขอบล่าง) ทำให้ Launch Explore บอกว่า "บินไม่ได้"
sources: other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS "a rating of 0 counts as none"
status_evidence: Re-verified da67341: ratings.ts:246-251 returns converged:false + stoppedBy when budget ends; kg = floor(lo) after the empty-stack flight, else 0. No reader of converged/stoppedBy in src/ui (only src/validation/report.ts). explore-level.ts:668 stores res.payloadLEO.kg as "computed"; review-panel.ts:387-392 prints it and hands it to host.rated(). Contradiction resolved: part2 "partial" only meant validation report reads it; UI still does not.
placement: B (Build owner B; small package before R3.4)
priority_rationale: A visible wrong number written into the student's design (slow school tablets, Ariane 64): directly hurts realism and trust.
acceptance: When converged=false the ratings box and review say "not finished (stopped after N flights): at least X kg" or "not computed", with Continue (another budget) and Stop; draft.ratings marks partial and modelResult treats it as unknown, not 0; Launch Explore verdict says "rating not computed" instead of "will not fly"; unit tests with an injected now() for both stop points; TH/EN/RU strings.
quality_guard: Search algorithm and budget unchanged (identical results when converged). Do not hide the gap by silently raising the budget (that would freeze nothing — it is in a worker — but would make slow devices wait without feedback); Continue is explicit.
user_benefit: Students on slow devices never see "nothing reaches orbit" for a rocket that does; their saved design keeps an honest "not finished" state.

title: Opening a saved design or a requirements row replaces the unsaved bench / design-lesson design without asking
title_th: เปิดแบบที่บันทึกไว้หรือแถวในหน้า requirements แล้วแบบที่ยังไม่บันทึกบน bench/บทเรียนถูกแทนที่โดยไม่ถาม
sources: other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS D07 "Opening a row replaces the unsaved design on the bench without asking"
other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS T01 "…during a design lesson replaces the lesson's design without asking"
status_evidence: No confirm/keep-aside guard in src/ui/build/*.ts (grep confirm|unsaved|dirty: none). satellite-level keeps an "aside" only for the lesson switch (satellite-level.ts:82-84), not for row/saved-design opens.
placement: B (Build owner B; data-safety package with M-BUILD-008/011, before R3.4)
priority_rationale: Silent loss of a student's unsaved work is a data-safety defect (owner requirement 2).
depends_on: cross:storage group B6 (numeric-drafts limit must not throw)
acceptance: Opening another design while the current one differs from its saved record offers Save / Keep aside (restorable from the drafts list) / Discard, never discards silently; design-lesson design kept aside and restored on return; keyboard accessible dialog; unit test + journey step; TH/EN/RU.
quality_guard: No change to stored formats; an untouched design opens without any prompt (no extra friction).
user_benefit: A student exploring requirement rows cannot lose the satellite they were working on.

title: Newer-version design file: message claims unknown parts "were left out" while any unknown field makes the whole file refused; record the forward-compatibility rule (D-22)
title_th: ไฟล์แบบจากเวอร์ชันใหม่: ข้อความบอกว่า "ตัดสิ่งที่ไม่รู้จักออก" แต่จริง ๆ ถ้ามีฟิลด์ใหม่จะปฏิเสธทั้งไฟล์; ต้องบันทึกกติกา forward-compat (D-22)
status_evidence: design-store.ts:244-251 marks newerVersion then validates the whole design; vehicle-spec.ts:68 and satellite-design.ts:150 refuse every unknown key ("is not a field of this version"); explore-store.ts:211-221 appends build.ex.store.fileNewer ("anything this version does not know was left out") only to files that were accepted, i.e. that had nothing unknown. Code verdict: behaviour = reject (matches PLAN R3.1); only the text is false.
placement: B (text fix now, Build owner B) + decision D-22 recorded in the decision register before R3.1
priority_rationale: False statement to the user about their data; cheap to fix; the policy decision gates R3.1.
depends_on: owner decision DEC:D-22 (recommend: reject with honest message, matching PLAN R3.1 and R1 archive previews)
acceptance: Accepted newer file: message says it was made by a newer version and everything in it was understood; refused newer file: localized message names the unknown fields (no English-only detail); same rule written once for design, mission, satellite and archive files; tests for both paths.
quality_guard: No change to what is accepted or refused unless the owner picks "strip and report"; then stripping must list every dropped field before saving.
user_benefit: Teachers sharing files across app versions get a truthful explanation.
notes: Conflict resolved: REMAINING treated wholesale refusal as the defect; PLAN R3.1 chooses refusal. Verdict: refusal stays (pending D-22), the misleading text is the defect.

title: Single ratings slot per draft: a late result for a vehicle no longer on screen overwrites valid ratings of the one on screen (B-19 race), plus ResultSlot-style freshness for review/ratings
title_th: ค่า rating เก็บได้ช่องเดียวต่อ draft: ผลที่มาช้าของแบบที่ไม่ได้แสดงแล้วเขียนทับค่าที่ถูกต้องของแบบปัจจุบัน (B-19) และสถานะความสดของผลแบบ ResultSlot
status_evidence: Re-read: explore-level.ts:663-668 writes draft.ratings with the job signature in .then(); the abort for a changed signature happens only in the next rAF compute (:327-329). Edit A→B→A within that window lets B's result overwrite A's valid ratings (A must be recomputed, 1–8 s). Display is never wrong (signature check in explore-model.ts:442). review-panel.ts:83 still uses a boolean stale; result-slot.ts used only by sky-panel/lifetime. REMAINING's "dropped as stale" description is half right: the stale result is correctly not shown; the real loss is the overwrite.
placement: PLAN R3.4 (stale checked revision acceptance)
priority_rationale: Rare, costs a recompute, never shows a wrong number; fix with the R3.4 freshness work.
acceptance: Ratings kept per signature (small map, e.g. last 4) or written only when the signature still matches; review panel shows "checked for revision N" via the shared freshness helper; unit test for the A→B→A race.
quality_guard: Identical ratings values; only bookkeeping changes. Stored draft format change (map) needs a migration test.
user_benefit: Undoing an edit brings back the ratings already computed instead of asking to wait again.

title: Ratings worker failing to load rejects with a bare error; give a clear retry/reload message (no blanket main-thread fallback)
title_th: เมื่อ worker คำนวณ rating โหลดไม่ได้ ให้ข้อความชัดเจนพร้อมลองใหม่/รีโหลด (ไม่ย้ายไปคำนวณบน main thread ทั้งหมด)
status_evidence: ratings-job.ts:38 w.onerror → reject(new Error(e.message)); a load failure gives an Event without message, so the UI shows build.ex.ratings.failed only. No pre-aborted signal check before new Worker (D1). No fake-Worker failure test for ratings/readiness.
placement: B (inside the shared job-runner package owned by the bundle group, D1; Build strings by B)
priority_rationale: Rare (stale tab, CSP, OOM) but currently unexplained to the user.
depends_on: cross:bundle group D1 shared job runner
acceptance: Load failure shows the app's update/reload text with Retry; pre-aborted signal rejects without creating a worker; fake-Worker tests for progress/result/error/abort for ratings and readiness.
quality_guard: Rejected direction: inline main-thread fallback for ratings (1–8 s of frozen page = lower smoothness). The existing constructor-throw fallback stays.
user_benefit: A clear next step instead of a generic failure.

title: Saved design keeps the vehicle, not how it was made: remix stretches reset to 100 %, payload and satellite design date not saved
title_th: แบบที่บันทึกเก็บแค่ยาน ไม่เก็บวิธีสร้าง: ค่ายืด remix กลับเป็น 100 %, ไม่เก็บ payload และวันออกแบบดาวเทียม
sources: other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS D06 "design date is kept with the unsaved design only"
status_evidence: docs/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md Build remix bullet and D06 list (files unchanged since 5eb18a2); design record schema stores VehicleSpec/SatelliteDesign only.
placement: PLAN R3.1 (same schema bump as the design envelope; S owner, B UI)
priority_rationale: Re-opening one's own work and finding it changed breaks trust and the experiment record.
acceptance: Design record v(n+1) optionally carries the edit recipe, payload and design date; old records open as today; a remix reopens with its stretches; round-trip export/import tests; older app refuses or reads per D-22.
quality_guard: Backward compatible: v(n) files unchanged and still readable; no change to the vehicle bytes.
user_benefit: A saved remix reopens exactly as the student left it.

title: Ratings computed in the Engineer review for a saved design are not written back to it
title_th: ค่า rating ที่คำนวณในหน้า review ระดับ Engineer ไม่ถูกบันทึกกลับไปยังแบบที่บันทึกไว้
status_evidence: engineer-level.ts:286-296 rated(): Explore source → rateExploreDesign; saved/sized source → bench only, no store write.
placement: PLAN R3.4
priority_rationale: Saves a 1–8 s recompute on reopen; must stay an explicit user action.
depends_on: M-BUILD-006 (only converged ratings are worth keeping)
acceptance: After rating a saved design the review offers "Keep these ratings with the design"; profile-scoped store write with revision check; test.
quality_guard: Never modify a saved record silently (explicit action); write through the R1.1 repository epoch rules.
user_benefit: Ratings survive a reload of a saved design.

title: Explore "Fly it" always targets the 500 km preset from the first site and names the payload "CubeSat rideshare dispenser" whatever its mass
title_th: ปุ่ม "Fly it" ใน Explore เล็งวงโคจร 500 km จากฐานแรกเสมอ และเรียก payload ว่า "CubeSat rideshare dispenser" ไม่ว่ามวลเท่าใด
status_evidence: explore-level.ts:594 and :687 siteById(spec.sites[0]); IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS Build remix bullet unchanged.
placement: PLAN R3.5 (Build row; uses R3.1 "design → configure mission" intent)
priority_rationale: Mislabelled payload and fixed target misrepresent the flight the student asked for (realism of the hand-off).
acceptance: Fly it offers site (from the design's sites) and target (presets reachable from it); payload labelled by mass class or "your payload (X kg)"; test that the mission matches the choice.
quality_guard: Default choice remains today's (500 km, first site) so nothing changes for users who just click.
user_benefit: The flight matches what the student designed for.

title: Main-thread insertion probe in satellite Fly it (up to 0.5 s per vehicle) — run the verdict probe in the existing readiness worker
title_th: การทดลองบินเข้าวงโคจรใน Fly it ของดาวเทียมรันบน main thread (สูงสุด 0.5 วินาทีต่อยาน) — ย้ายไปทำใน readiness worker ที่มีอยู่
sources: other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS D06 "one insertion probe can hold the page 0.5 s"
status_evidence: satellite-fly.ts header: "a marginal mission flies the insertion probe (up to half a second for a GTO)"; fleet scan runs one vehicle per setTimeout on the main thread.
placement: E (identical-output; Build owner B with the readiness worker)
priority_rationale: Half-second freezes while typing on the satellite page; same deterministic verdict computed off-thread.
acceptance: designVerdict computed in a worker; results deep-equal to the main-thread function on all templates × fleet (unit harness); no long task >50 ms on the satellite page while typing (perf journey); supersede semantics like ReadinessRunner.
quality_guard: Same function, same inputs → identical verdicts; stale verdict shown faded exactly as today until the new one arrives.
user_benefit: Smooth typing on the satellite designer, also on school tablets.

title: Figures/checks freshness contract: satellite checks read the new design against old figures for ~180 ms; readiness/ratings carry the checked revision
title_th: สัญญาความสดของตัวเลข: ระหว่างคำนวณใหม่ (~180 ms) การตรวจดาวเทียมอ่านแบบใหม่เทียบกับตัวเลขเก่า; readiness/rating ต้องระบุ revision ที่ตรวจ
sources: other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS D06 "While the figures are worked out again (about 180 ms) the checks read the new design against the old figures"
status_evidence: satellite-level.ts:71 keeps "the design, date and level the figures were last worked out for" but checks are evaluated against them while new figures compute; no shared freshness helper in Build.
placement: PLAN R3.4 (prerequisite of the R3.3 preview; B owner)
priority_rationale: Pictures and numbers must never disagree (G3 criterion); this is the shared mechanism for M-BUILD-009 too.
acceptance: One helper (reuse src/ui/result-slot.ts) gives every Build result {revision, fresh|computing|stale}; checks evaluated only against figures of the same revision or shown as "updating"; unit tests; no flicker (keep last-valid with stale styling).
quality_guard: No extra recomputation; figures identical; only labelling and gating change.
user_benefit: A check result never contradicts the numbers next to it.

title: Ratings of kick-stage / upper-stage vehicles: fly the planned burns (Vega-C LEO 31 % high, Ariane 64 16–22 % high, GTO post-insertion burns instantaneous, 16 matrix designs rate GTO > LEO)
title_th: rating ของยานที่มี kick stage/ขั้นบน: บินการจุดเครื่องตามแผนจริง (Vega-C LEO สูงไป 31 %, Ariane 64 สูง 16–22 %, GTO นับการจุดหลังเข้าวงโคจรเป็นทันที, 16 แบบได้ GTO > LEO)
status_evidence: IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS:494-502 unchanged (Vega-C 4 330 vs 3 300 kg; GTO post-insertion burns instantaneous); src/validation/report.ts RATING_REFERENCES keeps the miss visible. GTO>LEO anomaly (verified "unknown" before): mechanism confirmed by documentation — LEO needs direct insertion (noInsertion for weak stages on the F9 core) while GTO counts later burns as impulsive; not re-run.
placement: F (PLAN R4.3 known misses; owner P with B for ratings.ts)
priority_rationale: Ratings are the headline Build number; two documented misses and a physically impossible GTO>LEO pattern undermine realism.
acceptance: Restartable final stages rated from parking orbit through the planned burn with the real sequencer; Vega-C LEO and 700 km SSO within ±25 % of Arianespace; the other seven ratings stay in band; GTO burns finite; build-catalogue-matrix reports zero GTO>LEO for designs that cannot reach LEO (or each is explained); before/after table in the R4.3 report.
quality_guard: Rating changes are intended physics changes: before/after table, owner approval, no tolerance relaxation; flight fingerprints of catalogue vehicles must not move (ratings path only). Cost per rating may rise: keep within the time budget or the rating stays "not finished" (M-BUILD-006).
user_benefit: Rockets with upper stages get believable payload numbers.
notes: Physics group may list B-13/8-09 too; this item is the Build view of the same work.

title: Δv budget/flight model: each strap-on group at its own Isp and ignition time (PSLV air-lit), core throttle share beside strap-ons (Falcon Heavy, Angara-A5)
title_th: งบ Δv/แบบจำลองการบิน: strap-on แต่ละกลุ่มใช้ Isp และเวลาจุดของตัวเอง (PSLV จุดกลางอากาศ) และแบ่งคันเร่งแกนกลางเมื่อมี strap-on (Falcon Heavy, Angara-A5)
status_evidence: budget.ts:98-100 comment: "every strap-on group burns at the first group's Isp, and an air-lit group (igniteAt) is counted in the parallel phase from liftoff"; VehicleModel.deltaVRemaining is also used for event payloads in sim/ascent.ts:386,478 and sim/burns.ts:721,832 and by warnings/verdict-core.
placement: F (PLAN R4.3; owner P — shared VehicleModel)
priority_rationale: Wrong Δv for designs with unlike strap-on groups; affects warnings, verdicts and event text.
acceptance: Δv per strap-on group at own Isp and ignition; core flow with throttleWithBoosters; PSLV-XL/FH/Angara ideal Δv within 1 % of the flight model; affected event dv values listed in a before/after table.
quality_guard: Changes recorded event dv numbers and warnings: owner-approved golden updates only for named vehicles; trajectories unchanged (assert fleet trajectory fingerprints).
user_benefit: Correct Δv for mixed strap-on designs.

title: Sizing that reaches orbit at the designed Δv (+≤100 m/s): fairing carried to jettison, loss allowance from fleet median, upper-stage T/W; plus owner decisions D-9 (fairing rule) and the stretch mass rule
title_th: การกำหนดขนาดจรวดที่ถึงวงโคจรได้ที่ Δv ที่ออกแบบ (+≤100 m/s) พร้อมการตัดสินใจ D-9 (กติกา fairing) และกติกามวลเมื่อยืดถัง
sources: other-docs:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS D02 owner call (stretch mass rule)
status_evidence: IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS:503-513: 1 t launcher needs +500 m/s, 10 t +300, 5 t Baikonur none up to +1 000; only serial liquid stages; fairing by diameter. DECISIONS D-9 still open; stretch rule "awaiting the owner".
